summary: An on/off toggle for a setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from naming the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: On state. Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset (native defaultChecked).

required.note: Native required: must be on to submit (valueMissing while off). Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A <fieldset disabled> ancestor also disables it without touching this attribute.

size.note: Track and thumb size: default 32x20 track with a 16px thumb, sm 24x16 track with a 12px thumb. Label text keeps its size.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: The track: pill-shaped wrapper holding the native input and the thumb.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, stretched over the track and visually transparent; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Round knob; sits at the inline start when off and moves to the inline end when on (mirrored under dir=rtl). aria-hidden.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root; clicking it toggles.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle by the user. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary. Not fired when checked is set from code.

change.note: Toggle committed by the user. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl). Form value is synced before it fires.

focus-visible.note: Solid ring around the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end; position, not only color, shows the state.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor (:host(:disabled))

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl mixins (ElementInternals): setFormValue(value) only while on, null while off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing while off; error -> customError); formResetCallback restores the default checked attribute; formStateRestore restores checked; a disabled fieldset disables it through isDisabled and it is not submitted; <label for=host-id> toggles it.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20 (sm 24x16); the label next to it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; solid ring in switch.focus-ring.color around the track.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission, like the native checkbox; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). It does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; the browser exposes aria-checked true/false from its checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
thumb is aria-hidden; no on/off text inside the track
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the thumb and track transitions (WCAG 2.3.3)
announcements: on/off state change is announced natively by the switch role
error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)

useCases.when: A single setting that is either on or off
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label naming the setting

useCases.when: The effect of turning it on needs explaining
A settings form submitted with the rest of the page
useCases.use: sb-switch with name (value submitted only while on)

useCases.when: Space is tight, e.g. a dense settings list or table row

antiPatterns.pattern: A switch for choosing several items from a list, or for agreeing to terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as a setting that takes effect; selection and consent are checkbox choices (APG switch vs checkbox)

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch has only on and off

antiPatterns.pattern: Changing the label text with the state ("On" / "Off")
antiPatterns.why: The APG switch pattern keeps the label constant; the state is conveyed by the role
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label naming the setting

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default bg-input is neutral-200, below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
shadcn renders a <button role=switch> (Radix); the native input gives form validity and Space for free
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look, sizes (default, sm) and API; WAI-ARIA APG switch pattern for role and keyboard; Checkbox contract for the field layout and form behavior.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> or a <button role=switch>?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: native checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007 native-first). Space, required validity and the validation message come from the browser; it shares NativeControl with Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch (APG optional) or submit the form?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: Enter submits the form (implicit submission, as the native checkbox does and as Checkbox does, SB-0009); only Space toggles. Enter is optional in the APG switch pattern.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, same as Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores (native defaultChecked).

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: the reference's default (32x20 track, 16px thumb) and sm (24x16 track, 12px thumb), from the existing size.switch semantic tokens. Label typography does not change with size.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Does the label sit before or after the track?
openQuestions.answer: Recommended and chosen: after (track first), like Checkbox and the visual reference. No placement prop (YAGNI); a later need adds one.
